messages:
maya: Starting candidate creation thread for rc-49 (sha: ab12cd3). CI green (unit/integration/infra). Planning to promote in the 10:30 PT change window. Need QA, Security, Docs, and an oncall sheriff.
linus: I can take sheriff for this window. :raised_hand:
qa-jen: Kicking off smoke now. will post quick results in 10m.
qa-jen: smoke summary: 12/12 checks passed, latency spot-checks within baseline.
sec-sam: Quick security scan done. No unexpected external calls; no keys in logs. minor header warning only. OK from Sec pending ops hold.
docs-ana: I pushed release-notes draft to the repo: https://git.internal/release-notes/rc-49. 3 bullets + upgrade note for clients.
ops-sherpa: Ops notes: DB migration is async and behind a feature flag. We'll flip the flag after canary if metrics look stable. Increase min replicas by +20% during promo.
maya: Good. Canary plan: 1% for 15m, if stable -> 50% for 20m -> 100%. Rollback plan: revert flag, pin previous artifact, and scaledown.
linus: I'll watch latency and error-rate dashboards. Alert thresholds set: 2x error rate or 1.5x p95 latency.
sheriff: Acknowledged. I will be on call during the window.
maya: Ready to promote when QA and Sec signoff are final.
qa-jen: Post-canary smoke ran at 1%: no regressions observed. random sampling of responses looked fine.
sec-sam: No security signals during canary. good to proceed.
maya: Running promotion command:```/deploy promote --candidate rc-49 --pin --canary 1% --note "rc-49 smoke+security pass"```
deploy-bot: Promotion initiated. job_id=prom-20260322-77. canary=1%. artifact pinned: ab12cd3.
deploy-bot: Canary started: 1% traffic. ETA for next step ~15m. Monitoring hooks: perf, errors, costs.
linus: Watching. Initial p95 and error-rate look inline.
qa-jen: Post-canary quick checks: all green.
ops-sherpa: Advancing to 50% -> run:```/deploy scale-canary --job prom-20260322-77 --to 50%```
deploy-bot: Scaling canary to 50%. Expected ramp time 5m.
linus: 50% is stable. no new errors or latency spikes.
maya: Proceed to full rollout.```/deploy promote --job prom-20260322-77 --to 100% --finalize```
deploy-bot: Rolling out to 100%. will finalize artifact pin and update release tags.
ops-sherpa: Flipping DB feature flag post-100% rollout. Doing a controlled flip with backoff.
deploy-bot: Promotion complete. rc-49 (ab12cd3) pinned as prod default. job_id=prom-20260322-77.
maya: :tada: Promo complete. Release notes link: https://git.internal/release-notes/rc-49. Thanks team. If any regression, follow rollback:```/deploy rollback --to rc-48```
linus: Hotfix branch ready (hotfix/rc-49-urgent) if needed.
sheriff: Leaving note in incident log and handing off oncall. all good.
deploy-bot: Audit log updated: prom-20260322-77, actor=maya, pinned=ab12cd3, canary=1%, final=100%.
